title: compute/v1 Computer
description: The one unit of the compute layer: a machine reachable by SSH. kind device = a computer or server where the person installed the client (AgentDevice); kind sandbox = a cloud sandbox this layer created on demand (POST /v1/sandboxes), running the same client. Facts are reported as they are; differences between systems are not smoothed over (the Agent knows them). README.md: contracts/compute/v1/README.md.

name.description: The person's name for a device (「台式机」); for a sandbox the name its creator gave (POST /v1/sandboxes `name`).

own.description: The owner (identity/v1 `own`): the computer is in this owner's network and only tokens with this `own` reach it.

state.description: From the connection layer (the NetBird peer's status; for a sandbox also its provider's lifecycle), never stored as a second copy. online: its client is connected and SSH answers. offline: it should be reachable and is not (device switched off, network lost). sleeping: a stopped sandbox (:start wakes it). starting: a sandbox being created or started, or a device whose client is connecting.

version.description: The AgentDevice client version running on it.

sandbox.description: Present exactly when kind is sandbox.

facts.description: What the machine is, reported by its client (PUT /v1/computers/{id}/facts) and refreshed when it changes. Every value is what the system says; nothing is mapped to a common vocabulary beyond the enums below.

name.description: As the system names itself ("Windows 11 Pro", "Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS", "macOS 15.6").

arch.description: Go GOARCH naming, as the client (Go) reports it: amd64, arm64, 386, arm, riscv64, …

shell.description: The shell an SSH session of `user` (POST /v1/computers/{id}/access) runs commands in.

name.description: bash, zsh, fish, sh, pwsh, powershell, cmd, …

cores.description: Logical cores; a sandbox reports its vCPU limit (may be fractional).

software.description: Programs found on the PATH of `user` that the client looks for (toolchains, package managers, editors, runtimes), each as found.

specDigest.description: Digest of the spec it was created with (canonical JSON), for caching and comparison.

holds.description: Live holds. A temporary sandbox without one is reclaimed at `reclaimAt`.

reclaimAt.description: Present for a temporary sandbox that has no live hold: when it is removed (30 minutes after the last hold ended).
